title: decisions-pack
description: One voted pack of a /review-sheet, ids and verdicts only. No question text, no card HTML, no gloss text, no personal names. Aligned 27-10-2026 with the live emitter (csl-pyutil 0.23.0 plus the sheet's Save-to-GitHub payload) after six of nine committed packs were found to violate the previous shape: ISO `generated` is the VOTE moment (Uprava FINDINGS §611 / the S6 vote-leg decision), `reviewedAt` and the two timing measurements are retained additions, and `pack_size` is optional because the browser upload path never sends it.

sheet_id.description: Shared with the parent sheet and every sibling pack; never changed except through the A3 migration path.

pack_size.description: Item count this pack was cut to (the last pack of a sheet may hold fewer). OPTIONAL: the browser upload path omits it, and consumers use items.length, so a pack without it is valid.

generated.description: ISO-8601 `...Z` = the moment the vote was exported (the vote moment, per the S6 semantics); DD-MM-YYYY = the legacy issuance date. Both are committed history and both validate; new emitters send ISO.

reviewedAt.description: When the human pressed Save (csl-pyutil 0.23.0, retained for the S6 vote-leg timestamps). Optional and forward-only: packs written before 29-08-2026 do not carry it.

time_total_seconds.description: Total time the voter spent on the pack, when the sheet measured it.

decided.description: Count of items in this pack carrying a non-null decision.

reject_label.description: A short reason code when decision is reject; null otherwise.

note.description: Free-text curator note, <=280 chars, no HTML angle brackets, no dump of the card's question field. A pack violating this is refused upstream; the default on ambiguity is to truncate the note and keep the decision.

time_seconds.description: Time the voter spent on this card, when the sheet measured it.
